originality.rationale: The exact seven-rational-hyperplane Frobenius five-cycle distribution, two-line lower bound, and unique minimal projective orbit are not given by inspected genus-six class tables or by large-field monodromy estimates. The projective invariant requires new exact restriction factoring; no directly covering claim was located, subject to the explicit residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Complete genus-six class records could be postprocessed to derive the answer, and unindexed or unpublished arithmetic line-section tables might already contain the distribution.
Semantic mathematical record retrieval does not prove worldwide uniqueness.
Projective embedded isomorphism of plane quintics should not be conflated with abstract curve-isomorphism counts.
